BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Rule, Reeves, Shavers, Bernbaum, Pollet, Nance, and Timmons
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing a sales and use tax exemption for children's diapers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a sales and use tax exemption for children's diapers; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 82.12 RCW; creating a new section; and providing an effective date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of diapers.

(2) For purposes of this section, "diaper" means an absorbent garment that is reusable or disposable and is marketed to be worn by children, including infants or toddlers, who are incapable of or have difficulty controlling their bladder or bowel movements.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) This chapter does not apply to the use of diapers.
(2) The definition in section 1 of this act applies to this section.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 82.32.805 and 82.32.808 do not apply to this act.
